# uptrace_org_user (Resource)

Adds an existing user to an organization with a role. Idempotent — creating twice updates the role server-side. Pair with `uptrace_user` to manage the underlying user.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptrace_org" "main" {
  name = "Main"
}

resource "uptrace_user" "alice" {
  email = "alice@example.com"
}

resource "uptrace_org_user" "alice" {
  org_id  = uptrace_org.main.id
  user_id = uptrace_user.alice.id
  role    = "admin"
}

resource "uptrace_team" "platform" {
  org_id = uptrace_org.main.id
  name   = "Platform"
}

resource "uptrace_team_user" "alice_platform" {
  org_id      = uptrace_org.main.id
  team_id     = uptrace_team.platform.id
  org_user_id = uptrace_org_user.alice.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `org_id` (String) Organization ID. Changing this forces recreation.
- `role` (String) Organization role: owner, admin, member, viewer, billing_manager, or collaborator.
- `user_id` (String) User ID to attach. Changing this forces recreation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) OrgUser ID. Use this value when another resource needs an `org_user_id` (e.g. `uptrace_team_user`).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import uptrace_org_user.example 123:456
```
